Author: hiarc
Name: Ostinato
Description: Swaps the pressed action for the next step of your rotation, using per-job rules you can switch on and off.
TestingChangelog:
Test build for PR #14: Ground placement, Esuna priority, overlay resets, listing polish (M83–M86)

1. Ground-targeted heals (Asylum, Liturgy of the Bell) are placed the moment you press them, no targeting circle: on your hard target if it is a party member, otherwise on you.
2. Esuna now cleanses tanks first, then healers, then DPS (only members with a debuff it can remove). New "DPS" target choice for any Route stack.
3. Config → Overlay now has "Reset current job (<job>)" and "Reset all jobs" in place of one button per job.

Minor: Rescue no longer shows a "no default" warning; cleanse cards are labelled "cleansing stack"; shorter plugin description, "by hiarc", one command per line in the help.
